title: 第3章 司狱有三层第4章 斩马将孟涛
slug: 镇守仙秦地牢吞妖六十年
content_zh:
接别的男人？
张远脑海里浮现昨晚那小娘羞答答娇滴滴讨饶的模样，还有今早搂着自己的背，低低抽泣的声音。
因为差了些银钱，就将这么好的小娘推出去？
银钱没了可以再赚，小娘没了，怕是再遇不到了。
张远变幻的神色都被张全武看在眼里。
男人嘛，也只有这般血气方刚时候，才会心中还热乎。
时间久了，心就硬了。
“全武哥，还差多少银钱？”张远吸一口气，开口问道。
张全武伸出巴掌示意一下。
“纹银五十两。”
五十两。
这么多！
皂衣卫的俸禄一个月五两，已经是府城中顶丰厚的，一月日日酒肉吃喝也用不完。
五十两，张远手头上所有银钱加一起也不过十两不到。
看他神色，张全武凑近些：“老弟，五十两不是小数，要不就算了吧？”
“当然，若你真的想要那小娘，又拿不出银钱，老哥可以给你指条路。”
张远沉默片刻，微微低头，压低声音：“全武哥，还请教我。”
张全武的目光落在张远腰间的雁翎刀上，轻笑一声：“杀人。”
杀人。
昨日刑使任务完成，衣兜里被放了五两纹银。

镇抚司做刑使杀人，一次五两。
张远压住心头的喜悦。
不是为了银钱，而是自己不用找别的理由了。
为了印证是不是杀人就有血珠，他还在想找什么理由才能再次担任刑使呢。
“好。”张远重重点头。
“那我就送你到这了，没有腰牌，司狱重地外人是不能进的。”张全武笑一声，向着前方石门边的几道身影拱拱手，转身就走。
张远抬头，前方石门厚重，其上刻着狰狞兽纹，透着一丝森寒之气，让人不敢直视。
立在石门前的三人身形有些干瘦，穿的衣袍不是皂衣，乃是黑色，不是旗官孙泽身上的黑袍，是通体的灰黑。
雁翎刀还是雁翎刀。
张远所知，镇抚司中衣袍不同，职责也是不同的。
还有武道修为和官职不同，身份也不同。
当初问大哥，总被推脱，说是镇抚司隐秘不得窥探。
张远将孙泽给他的黑色腰牌拿出来。
对面守在门口的三人相互看一眼，都是咧嘴笑。
“走吧，既然是来司狱当值，那就先进来看看。”当先满脸皱纹的老卒摆摆手，转身往厚重石门中走去。
张远忙快步跟上。
“你说，这小子待会会不会吓尿？”
“说不到，反正第一回进司狱的，能站着走出来的不多。”
身后，值守门庭的两人声音中带着戏谑传来。
张远没有回头，就跟着身前老卒快步疾行。

这道路似乎是往地下行，周围气息越发阴冷，墙壁也是青石，便是白日，隔着几丈也要插着燃烧的火把照明。
content_en:
Picking up another man?
Zhang Yuan's mind flashed to the shy and coquettish look of the young lady begging for mercy last night, as well as the sound of her arms hugging his back and sobbing softly this morning.
Why would you push such a good girl out because you are short of some money?
If the money is gone, you can make more money. If the wife is gone, I'm afraid I won't meet her again.
Zhang Yuan's changing expressions were all seen by Zhang Quanwu.
Men, only when they are full of energy can their hearts still be warm.
As time goes by, the heart becomes hardened.
"Brother Quan Wu, how much silver is left?" Zhang Yuan took a breath and asked.
Zhang Quanwu stretched out his palm to signal.
"Fifty taels of silver pattern."
Fifty taels.
so much!
Zaoyiwei's salary is five taels a month, which is already the most generous in the city. He can eat and drink every day in a month.
Fifty taels, all the money Zhang Yuan had on hand together was less than ten taels.
Seeing his expression, Zhang Quanwu came closer and said, "Brother, fifty taels is not a decimal, so why not just forget it?"
"Of course, if you really want that girl but can't afford the money, I can show you the way."
Zhang Yuan was silent for a moment, lowered his head slightly, and lowered his voice: "Brother Quan Wu, please teach me."
Zhang Quanwu's eyes fell on the Yanling knife at Zhang Yuan's waist, and he chuckled: "Kill."
Kill people.
Yesterday, the executioner's mission was completed, and five taels of silver were placed in his pocket.
The Zhenfu Division was responsible for killing people, five liang at a time.
Zhang Yuan suppressed the joy in his heart.
Not for money, but because I don’t have to find other reasons.
In order to prove whether there are blood beads in killing people, he is still trying to find a reason to serve as a torture envoy again.
"Okay." Zhang Yuan nodded heavily.
"Then I will send you here. Without a waist card, outsiders are not allowed to enter the prison." Zhang Quanwu smiled, cupped his hands to the figures beside the stone door in front, turned around and left.
Zhang Yuan raised his head and saw that the stone door in front of him was thick and engraved with ferocious animal patterns, giving off a hint of coldness that made people dare not look directly.
The three people standing in front of the stone gate were a little thin, and the robes they wore were not soap clothes, but black. They were not the black robes worn by flag officer Sun Ze, but were all gray and black.
Yan Ling Dao is still Yan Ling Dao.
Zhang Yuan knew that the Zhenfu Division had different robes and different responsibilities.
There are also different martial arts cultivation and official positions, and different identities.
When I first asked my eldest brother, I was always pushed away, saying that the secrets of the Zhenfu Division were not allowed to be pried into.
Zhang Yuan took out the black waistband Sun Ze gave him.
The three people guarding the door opposite looked at each other and grinned.
"Let's go. Since we are here to be on duty in the prison, let's come in and take a look first." The wrinkled old soldier waved his hand, turned around and walked into the thick stone door.
Zhang Yuan hurriedly followed.
"Tell me, will this kid pee in fear later?"
"I can't say that. Anyway, not many people who enter the prison for the first time can walk out standing."
Behind him, the voices of the two men guarding the door came with a hint of joking.
Zhang Yuan didn't look back and just walked quickly with the old soldier in front of him.
The road seemed to be going underground, and the atmosphere around it was getting colder and colder. The walls were made of bluestone, and even in the daytime, there were burning torches inserted a few feet away to illuminate them.
